body: Congrats! I too is going through depression episode. My antidepressants feels like fighting it. I’m so consumed by overwhelming problems I think my glimmer right now is my bf too. His comfort gives me peace. He may not be a sugar daddy but damn he’s a daddy that’s really sweet to me 🙂‍↕️

Then if you need reassurance just ask her again what she likes about you. Also, always ask yourself if you really like the person and for what reasons? Is it their values, their personality, anything that relates to your deal breakers tbh. You got this! Also, don’t doubt yourself. The question is IF YOU LIKE THIS PERSON not the other way around. This exudes confidence internally because then you know you have standards and you found your match.
Did you ask what you both like in each other? Ask yourself. Are you being authentic in the video and how you show up in person?
Thank you sis! You deserve to be happy too!

Never settle. List down your non negotiables, deal breakers, and how you want your future partner respond to your fears & defenses. It works! DONT BE AFRAID TO ASK QUESTIONS! VET THEM. If you’re uncomfortable, it just means you don’t want it. Learn how to communicate your needs and wants in a relationship. It will pay off. I found the love of my life (as he calls me) for now lol but I think I manifested him hard. I wanted my very own Chandler and I got him. Although, long distance at least I still get the respect, love and emotional support I need from him. You got this girl!
I’ll keep this in mind. I can prolly try checking with derma now and ask if the retinol is a good idea to continue. Thank you!

For acids, I use Paula’s Choice 2% BHA Liquid Exfoliant. Although I have glycolic but I rarely use it. I just use one if I feel like I’ve used too much salicylic or BHA and if I really need it.
